verdicts.reason: A: the headline leads, but the body copy column is so large it competes with the headline. The 'Reserve a Case' CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill and the legal text is unreadable. The dark header bar survives only as a stray black sliver at top right, with an orphan rule line above the logo. B has all of A's flaws, and the leftover dark bar also covers and cuts off the first line of body copy ('Each bottle is filled by'). Its headline's last line also runs almost into the body column.
